name: Long Beach to Avalon
blurb: The crossing: from Queens Gate straight across the San Pedro Channel to the mouth of Avalon Bay. 22 miles, most of it out of sight of anything but the island.

name: Long Beach to the Isthmus
blurb: Out through Queens Gate and west-south-west across the channel to Two Harbors, 25 miles, crossing both shipping lanes. Bird Rock and Ship Rock mark the way in.

name: Avalon to the Isthmus
blurb: Up the front side of the island from the Casino, a mile off the cliffs all the way, to Isthmus Cove. Fourteen miles in the lee, where the breeze comes and goes. The marks keep you out of the calms under the cliffs: there is no wind in there, and nothing to anchor in.

name: Round the platforms
blurb: From Queens Gate out to the Beta field: leave Edith and Ellen to port, round outside Eureka and come back up past Elly. Twenty-four miles, the rigs growing out of the haze for an hour before you reach them. Every mark is a quarter of a mile or more off the steel: they are solid.
